                    @* MeasurementQuantityId *@
                    <Validation AsyncValidator="ValidatingMeasurementQuantity">
                        <Field>
                            @{
                                string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentDto>(x => x.MeasurementQuantityId);
                                string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<EquipmentDto>(x => x.MeasurementQuantityId) ?? elementId;
                            }
                            <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                            <SelectList ElementId="@elementId"
                                        TItem="MeasurementQuantityDto"
                                        TValue="short"
                                        Data="@measurementQuantities"
                                        TextField="@((item) => item.Name)"
                                        ValueField="@((item) => item.Id!.Value)"
                                        DefaultItemText=@(WordsResource.SelectOf.Format(elementLabel))
<|editable_region_start|>
                                        DefaultItemValue="0"
                                        DefaultItemDisabled="true"
                                        @bind-SelectedValue="model.MeasurementQuantityId">
                                <Feedback>
                                    <ValidationError/>
                                </Feedback>
                            </SelectList>
                        </Field>
                    </Validation>
                    <|user_cursor_is_here|>
                    <Field>
                        @{
                            string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentDto>(x => x.EquipmentGroup.UsageId);
                            string elementLabel = AttributesHelper.GetDisplayNameValue<EquipmentDto>(x => x.EquipmentGroup.UsageId) ?? elementId;
                        }
                        <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                        <TextEdit ReadOnly="true" ElementId="@elementId" Text="@model.EquipmentGroup.UsageName"/>
                    </Field>
<|editable_region_end|>


                    @* IsReference *@
                    <Validation>
                        <Field>
                            @{
                                string elementId = ReflectionHelper.GetPropertyName<EquipmentDto>(x => x.IsReference);
                                string elementLabel = "نوع تجهیز";
                            }
                            <FieldLabel For="@elementId">@elementLabel</FieldLabel>
                            <RadioGroup ElementId="@elementId" Name="@elementId" TValue="bool" Color="Color.Primary" @bind-CheckedValue="model.IsReference">
                                <Radio Value="true">تجهیز مرجع</Radio>
                                <Radio Value="false">تجهیز غیر مرجع</Radio>
                            </RadioGroup>
                            <ValidationError/>
                        </Field>
                    </Validation>
                </Column>
